lesson.title: 解指数方程
lesson.description: 统一底数、系统试值与图解，以及复利、增长、半衰期和指数不等式；保留本节全部原题和旁注问答。

en.title: Solving Exponential Equations
en.description: Common bases, systematic trial, graphs, compound interest, growth, half-life, and exponential inequalities, with every section problem and margin question.

concepts.title: 用指数法则统一底数
concepts.summary: 当底数互为幂时，用 $a^{mn}=(a^m)^n$、$a^pa^q=a^{p+q}$ 和 $a^{-p}=1/a^p$ 将各项改写为同底数幂。

method.title: 识别底数
method.body: 先把 4、8、16 写成 2 的幂，或把 9、27、81 写成 3 的幂。

method.title: 处理根式
method.body: 对正数 $a$，用 $\sqrt[n]{a}=a^{1/n}$，再乘外面的指数。

pitfalls: 乘幂时乘指数；同底数相乘时才加指数。

en.title: Rewrite powers with a common base
en.summary: When bases are powers of one another, use $(a^m)^n=a^{mn}$, $a^pa^q=a^{p+q}$, and $a^{-p}=1/a^p$ to rewrite them with a common base.

method.title: Recognize bases
method.body: Write 4, 8, 16 as powers of 2, or 9, 27, 81 as powers of 3.

method.title: Handle radicals
method.body: For positive $a$, use $\sqrt[n]{a}=a^{1/n}$, then multiply by the outer exponent.

pitfalls: Multiply exponents for a power of a power; add exponents only for multiplication of powers with the same base.

concepts.title: 同底数指数方程
concepts.summary: 对实指数函数，若 $c>0$ 且 $c\ne1$，则 $c^u=c^v$ 当且仅当 $u=v$。先统一底数，再解指数中的方程并代回核对。

method.title: 比较并核对
method.body: 解 $x+2=3x$ 得 $x=1$；原式两边都为 64。

pitfalls: 不能在底数不同的式子中直接令指数相等；负底数不定义整个实数域上的实指数函数。

en.title: Equate exponents with the same base
en.summary: For a real exponential function with $c>0$ and $c\ne1$, $c^u=c^v$ if and only if $u=v$. Rewrite both sides with the same base, solve the exponent equation, and check by substitution.

method.title: Use one base
method.body: For example, rewrite $4^{x+2}=64^x$ as $4^{x+2}=4^{3x}$.

method.title: Equate and check
method.body: Solve $x+2=3x$ to get $x=1$; both original sides equal 64.

pitfalls: Do not equate exponents while bases differ. A negative base does not define a real exponential function on all real exponents.

concepts.title: 系统试值与图解近似
concepts.summary: 不能用本节的幂法则统一底数时，可反复试值，或画 $y=L(x)$ 和 $y=R(x)$ 求交点；也可画 $y=L(x)-R(x)$ 求零点。

method.title: 夹住目标
method.body: 选择两个试值，使函数值分居目标两侧；逐渐缩小区间。

method.title: 读图并舍入
method.body: 调整窗口看清交点或零点；最后一步才按要求舍入，并标明近似号。

pitfalls: 交点的横坐标才是方程的解；负时间在纯代数题中允许，在实际情境中须检查。

en.title: Systematic trial and graphical solutions
en.summary: When the bases cannot be rewritten by the power laws used in this section, refine trial values, graph $y=L(x)$ and $y=R(x)$ for an intersection, or graph $y=L(x)-R(x)$ for a zero.

method.title: Bracket the target
method.body: Choose two trial values whose function values straddle the target, then narrow the interval.

method.title: Read and round
method.body: Adjust the window to show the intersection or zero. Round only at the end and mark an approximation.

pitfalls: The solution is the horizontal coordinate of the intersection. Negative time may be valid algebraically but must be checked against a context.

concepts.title: 增长、衰减和计息期
concepts.summary: 增长/衰减可用 $A=A_0b^{t/h}$。复利 $A=P(1+r/m)^{mt}$ 中，$r$ 是年利率的小数，$m$ 是每年计息次数，$t$ 以年计。

method.title: 定义变量与起点
method.body: $t=0$ 为初始投资或初始样本；明确增长因子、时间单位和 $t\ge0$。

method.title: 区分模型与到账
method.body: 连续延伸模型可给小数时间；若只在完整计息期入账，达到至少目标时将期数向上取整。

pitfalls: 年利率须除以每年计息次数；计算完期数后再换成年。

en.title: Growth, decay, and compounding periods
en.summary: Growth and decay can be modelled by $A=A_0b^{t/h}$. In compound interest $A=P(1+r/m)^{mt}$, $r$ is the decimal annual rate, $m$ is compounding periods per year, and $t$ is in years.

method.title: Define variables and origin
method.body: Take $t=0$ at the initial investment or sample. State the multiplier, time units, and $t\ge0$.

method.title: Distinguish model time from crediting
method.body: A continuous extension gives a fractional time. If interest is credited only at complete periods, round the number of periods upward to meet at least the target.

pitfalls: Divide the annual rate by periods per year, then convert the solved number of periods back to years.

concepts.title: 指数不等式与换元
concepts.summary: 本节拓展：底数 $c>1$ 时 $c^u>c^v\Leftrightarrow u>v$；$0<c<1$ 时不等号反向。出现 $4^{2x}$ 与 $4^x$ 可令 $u=4^x>0$。

method.title: 先辨单调性
method.body: 底数大于 1 时保持不等号；底数在 0 与 1 之间时反向。

method.title: 保留换元限制
method.body: 解出代数候选 $u$ 后只保留 $u>0$，再求 $x$ 并代回。

pitfalls: 严格不等式不包括交点；指数值永远为正。

en.title: Exponential inequalities and substitution
en.summary: From the extension exercises: for $c>1$, $c^u>c^v\Leftrightarrow u>v$; for $0<c<1$, reverse the inequality. When $4^{2x}$ and $4^x$ occur together, set $u=4^x>0$.

method.title: Check monotonicity
method.body: Keep inequality direction for a base above 1; reverse it for a base between 0 and 1.

method.title: Retain substitution restrictions
method.body: After solving the algebraic equation, keep only $u>0$, solve for $x$, and substitute back.

pitfalls: Strict inequalities exclude intersection points; real exponential values with positive base are always positive.

questions.prompt: (a) 补完表格：对 $n=-2,-1,0,1,2$，分别求 $(\frac12)^n$、$2^n$、$4^n$ 的值，并用指数法则把每项改写为底数 2 的幂。(b) 这些等价表达式有什么规律？与同伴讨论。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 将底数从 $\frac12,2,4$ 改成 2 时，指数分别变为原指数的负数、原指数和两倍。对每行，前两列互为倒数，第三列是中间列的平方。这些代数关系可作为同伴讨论的核对依据。

en.prompt: (a) Complete the table for $n=-2,-1,0,1,2$: substitute into $(\frac12)^n$, $2^n$, and $4^n$, and rewrite each expression as an equivalent power with base 2. (b) What patterns do you observe in the equivalent expressions? Discuss with a partner.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Rewriting bases $\frac12,2,4$ using base 2 negates, retains, or doubles the exponent. In each row the first two entries are reciprocals, and the third is the square of the middle entry. These identities provide a check for the partner discussion.

en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 探究 1

questions.prompt: 对探究 1 表中 $2^n$ 一列的每个式子，找出其他两列中与它等值、但底数不同的指数式。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 一般地，$2^n=(\frac12)^{-n}=4^{n/2}$；当 $n=-1$ 或 1 时，对应的底数 4 指数为 $-\frac12$ 或 $\frac12$，不在原表中，因此原表的底数 4 一列没有这两个匹配项。

en.prompt: For each expression in the $2^n$ column of the table in Investigate 1, identify equivalent expressions with different bases in the other columns.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: In general $2^n=(\frac12)^{-n}=4^{n/2}$. For $n=-1$ or 1, the base-4 exponents are $-\frac12$ or $\frac12$, which are absent from the original table; those two entries have no base-4 match within the table.

en.answer: $2^n=(\frac12)^{-n}=4^{n/2}$; within the table the base-4 column matches only $n=-2,0,2$.
en.label: Investigate 2

questions.label: 探究 2

questions.prompt: 考虑 $2^x=8^{x-1}$。(a) 说明怎样把等式改写成同底数。(b) 说明如何利用这一点求 $x$ 并求解。(c) 在同一坐标系中画出 (a) 等式两边的指数函数，说明交点与 (b) 所求解的关系。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) $y=2^x$ 过 $(0,1),(1,2)$；$y=8^{x-1}$ 过 $(0,\frac18),(1,1)$。独立绘图显示交点 $(\frac32,2\sqrt2)$。交点的横坐标就是两函数值相等的 $x$，与 (b) 一致。

questions.answer: (a) $2^x=2^{3x-3}$；(b) $x=\frac32$；(c) 交点 $(\frac32,2\sqrt2)$ 的横坐标为解。

en.prompt: Consider $2^x=8^{x-1}$. (a) Explain how to rewrite the equation with the same bases. (b) Describe how this helps you solve for $x$, then solve. (c) Graph the exponential functions on both sides on the same axes and explain how their intersection relates to your solution.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Base 2 is valid and is not 1, so $x=3x-3$, giving $2x=3$ and $x=\frac32$. Substitution gives $2^{3/2}=8^{1/2}=2\sqrt2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) The curve $y=2^x$ passes through $(0,1),(1,2)$; $y=8^{x-1}$ passes through $(0,\frac18),(1,1)$. The independent plot shows intersection $(\frac32,2\sqrt2)$. Its horizontal coordinate makes the function values equal, agreeing with (b).

en.answer: (a) $2^x=2^{3x-3}$; (b) $x=\frac32$; (c) the intersection is $(\frac32,2\sqrt2)$, whose horizontal coordinate is the solution.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 3

questions.label: 反思与回应 3

questions.prompt: (a) 考虑 $3^x=4^{2x-1}$，能否用步骤 3(a) 的同样方法求解？说明。(b) 当指数方程的项具有不同底数时，这种解法有什么限制？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 本节所用的整数/有理数幂方法不能把 3 和 4 改写为同一底数的有理次幂：若存在 $3^p=4^q$ 且非零整数 $p,q$，两边的质因数分别只含 3 和 2，不可能相等。因此不能直接比较原指数。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 同底数法要求能先将两边改写成同一合法底数的单个幂；底数不同本身并不保证可这样改写。可改用试值或图解；例如两曲线在 $x\approx0.8281$ 相交。后续的对数方法能处理更一般底数。

questions.answer: (a) 不能用本节的有理幂换底法直接求解。(b) 需要可统一底数；否则可用试值或图解近似。

en.prompt: (a) Consider $3^x=4^{2x-1}$. Can it be solved in the same way as step 3(a)? Explain. (b) What are the limitations when solving exponential equations with terms having different bases?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) The integer/rational-power method used here cannot rewrite 3 and 4 with a common base using rational exponents: nonzero integer powers $3^p=4^q$ would have incompatible prime factors 3 and 2. Thus the original exponents cannot be equated.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Equating exponents requires first expressing each side as a single power of the same valid base. Different bases need not permit this rewrite by elementary power laws. Use trial or graphs instead; here the curves intersect at $x\approx0.8281$. Later logarithmic methods handle more general bases.

en.answer: (a) The rational-power common-base method does not apply directly. (b) A common-base rewrite is required; otherwise trial or graphical approximation can be used.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 4

questions.label: 反思与回应 4

questions.prompt: 教材把 $4^{2x}=8^{x+1}$ 改写为 $2^{4x}=2^{3x+3}$，再令 $4x=3x+3$。旁注问：“两边为同底数幂，所以指数相等”对所有底数都正确吗？说明。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 对 $c>0$ 且 $c\ne1$，函数 $c^x$ 严格单调，因此 $c^u=c^v$ 必有 $u=v$。教材示例用底数 2，得 $x=3$；代回两边均为 $2^{12}=4096$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 并非所有底数都适用：$1^2=1^3$ 但 $2\ne3$；$0^2=0^3$ 也不能推出指数相等，而且零底数不允许所有实指数。负底数不能给出整个实数域上的实指数函数；如 $(-1)^2=(-1)^4$。本节实指数函数应采用 $c>0,c\ne1$ 的完整条件。

questions.answer: 不是。实指数函数的充分且标准条件为 $c>0,c\ne1$；教材所列 $c\ne-1,0,1$ 仍须补上正底数条件。

en.prompt: The text rewrites $4^{2x}=8^{x+1}$ as $2^{4x}=2^{3x+3}$ and then sets $4x=3x+3$. The margin asks: Is the statement that equal powers with the same base have equal exponents true for all bases? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: For $c>0$ and $c\ne1$, $c^x$ is strictly monotonic, so $c^u=c^v$ implies $u=v$. The displayed base-2 example gives $x=3$; both original sides equal $2^{12}=4096$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: It is not true for all bases: $1^2=1^3$ but $2\ne3$; $0^2=0^3$ also fails, and base zero does not allow all real exponents. Negative bases do not give real exponential functions on all real exponents; for example $(-1)^2=(-1)^4$. The full condition for this real-exponential context is $c>0,c\ne1$.

en.answer: No. The standard condition in the real-exponential setting is $c>0,c\ne1$; the printed exclusion $c\ne-1,0,1$ still needs the positive-base qualification.
en.label: Link the Ideas: base restrictions

questions.label: 联系概念：底数限制

en.prompt: Rewrite each expression as a power with a base of 3: (a) $27$; (b) $9^2$; (c) $27^{1/3}(\sqrt[3]{81})^2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) $27^{1/3}(\sqrt[3]{81})^2=(3^3)^{1/3}((3^4)^{1/3})^2=3^1\cdot3^{8/3}=3^{1+8/3}=3^{11/3}$. Both bases are positive, so the radicals and rational powers are defined.

en.label: Example 1: Change the Base of Powers

en.prompt: Write each expression as a power with base 2: (a) $4^3$; (b) $\frac18$; (c) $8^{2/3}(\sqrt{16})^3$.
en.label: Your Turn 1

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 也可画 $y=4^{x+2}$ 与 $y=64^x$；在独立解析图中，交点为 $(1,64)$，横坐标同样为 1。

en.prompt: Solve each equation: (a) $4^{x+2}=64^x$; (b) $4^{2x}=8^{2x-3}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Alternatively graph $y=4^{x+2}$ and $y=64^x$. Their intersection in the independent solution plot is $(1,64)$, again giving horizontal coordinate 1.

en.label: Example 2: Solve an Equation by Changing the Base

en.prompt: Solve. Check your answers using graphing technology: (a) $2^{4x}=4^{x+3}$; (b) $9^{4x}=27^{x-1}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $2^{4x}=2^{2x+6}$, so $4x=2x+6$ and $x=3$. Both original sides equal $2^{12}=4096$, and the two graphs meet at $(3,4096)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $(3^2)^{4x}=(3^3)^{x-1}$ gives $3^{8x}=3^{3x-3}$. From $8x=3x-3$, $5x=-3$, hence $x=-\frac35=-0.6$. Both original sides equal $3^{-24/5}\approx0.005126$; the independent graph has intersection coordinate $x=-0.6$.

en.label: Your Turn 2

questions.prompt: Christina 想买一辆 5900 元的汽车，已存有 5000 元。若把钱存入年利率 6.12%、按季度复利的定期存款，她需要存多久才有足够的钱买车？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 因为利息按季度入账，检查完整期数：10 季度余额约为 $5819.88$ 元，不足；11 季度约为 $5908.92$ 元，足够。所以最早完整计息期为第 11 季度，即 $11/4=2.75$ 年。

questions.answer: 最早在 11 个季度后，即 2.75 年（2 年 9 个月）；连续延伸模型达到精确 5900 元的时间约为 2.7251 年。

en.prompt: Christina plans to buy a car costing 5900 dollars. She has saved 5000 dollars. How long must she invest in a term deposit paying 6.12% per year, compounded quarterly, before she has enough to buy the car?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let $n$ be the number of compounding quarters since deposit. The quarterly rate is $i=0.0612/4=0.0153$. Using $A=P(1+i)^n$, the target equation is $5900=5000(1.0153)^n$, or $1.18=1.0153^n$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Systematic trial gives $1.0153^{10}\approx1.1639756<1.18$ and $1.0153^{11}\approx1.1817844>1.18$. Refining the bracket, or reading the zero of $y=1.0153^n-1.18$, gives $n\approx10.9005$ for the continuous extension, about $2.7251$ years.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Because interest is credited quarterly, check complete periods: after 10 quarters the balance is about 5819.88 dollars, insufficient; after 11 it is about 5908.92 dollars, sufficient. The earliest complete compounding period is therefore quarter 11, or $11/4=2.75$ years.

en.answer: The earliest complete crediting period is 11 quarters, or 2.75 years (2 years 9 months). The continuous extension reaches exactly 5900 dollars at about 2.7251 years.
en.label: Example 3: Solve Problems Involving Exponential Equations With Different Bases

questions.label: 例题 3：不同底数的指数应用

questions.prompt: 例题 3 使用 $1.18=1.0153^n$ 试值时，为什么选择整数作为 $n$？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $n$ 表示已完成的计息季度数；季度利息在各季末入账，实际账户的完整期余额用 $n=0,1,2,\ldots$ 表示。因此为判断何时足够买车，应优先比较整数期。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $n=10$ 时约为 $5819.88$ 元，$n=11$ 时约为 $5908.92$ 元；虽然连续插值的根约为 $10.9005$，第一次完整计息后达到目标仍为 11 季度。

questions.answer: 因为 $n$ 是完整计息季度数，实际达到至少目标余额时须取向上的整数期数。

en.prompt: In Example 3, why choose whole numbers for $n$ when trying values in $1.18=1.0153^n$?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $n$ counts completed compounding quarters. Quarterly interest is credited at each quarter end, so complete-period balances use $n=0,1,2,\ldots$. Integer periods therefore determine when the credited balance is enough.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: At $n=10$ the balance is about 5819.88 dollars; at $n=11$ it is about 5908.92 dollars. Although the continuously interpolated root is about $10.9005$, the first complete crediting period reaching the target is still quarter 11.

en.answer: Because $n$ counts complete compounding quarters, meeting at least the target requires rounding the period count upward.
en.label: Example 3 margin: Why whole periods?

questions.label: 例题 3 旁注：为何取整数期数？

questions.prompt: 画 $y=1.0153^x-1.18$ 并找 $x$ 截距，为什么与分别画等式两边并找交点相似？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $1.0153^x=1.18$ 当且仅当 $1.0153^x-1.18=0$。因此曲线 $y=1.0153^x$ 与水平线 $y=1.18$ 交点的横坐标，也就是差函数的零点横坐标。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 两种图解均给 $x\approx10.9005$。原交点约为 $(10.9005,1.18)$，差函数的截距约为 $(10.9005,0)$；纵坐标不同，但所求横坐标相同。

questions.answer: 把一边移到另一边，将“两个函数相等”转为“差为 0”；两种图解有相同的解。

en.prompt: How is graphing $y=1.0153^x-1.18$ and finding its $x$-intercept similar to graphing the two sides of the equation and finding their intersection?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $1.0153^x=1.18$ if and only if $1.0153^x-1.18=0$. The horizontal coordinate where $y=1.0153^x$ meets $y=1.18$ is therefore also the zero of the difference function.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Both graphical methods give $x\approx10.9005$. The original intersection is approximately $(10.9005,1.18)$, whereas the difference-function intercept is approximately $(10.9005,0)$. Their ordinates differ, but the required abscissa is the same.

en.answer: Moving one side to the other converts equal function values into a zero difference, so both graphing methods give the same solution.
en.label: Example 3 margin: Zeros and intersections

questions.label: 例题 3 旁注：零点和交点

questions.prompt: 把 1000 元存入年利率 8.3%、半年复利的账户，多久后能增长到 1490 元？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 实际半年末余额在第 9 期约为 $1441.89$ 元、第 10 期约为 $1501.73$ 元。若仅在计息日入账，最早需 10 个半年，即 5 年。

questions.answer: 最早完整计息期为 5 年；连续延伸模型给约 4.90 年。

en.prompt: Determine how long 1000 dollars must be invested in an account earning 8.3% per year, compounded semi-annually, before it increases to 1490 dollars.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The half-year rate is $i=0.083/2=0.0415$. Let $n$ count half-year periods: $1490=1000(1.0415)^n$, so $1.49=1.0415^n$, and years are $t=n/2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Trial gives $1.0415^9\approx1.4418944<1.49$ and $1.0415^{10}\approx1.5017331>1.49$. A graph or finer trial gives continuous period count $n\approx9.8071$, or about $4.90355$ years.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: At complete half-year ends, the balance is about 1441.89 dollars at period 9 and 1501.73 dollars at period 10. If credit occurs only on those dates, the earliest sufficient balance is after 10 half-years, or 5 years.

en.answer: Five years at complete crediting dates; the continuous extension gives approximately 4.90 years.
en.label: Your Turn 3

questions.label: 配套练习 3

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (d) $16=2\cdot2\cdot2\cdot2=2^4$。

en.prompt: Write each expression with base 2: (a) $4^6$; (b) $8^3$; (c) $(\frac18)^2$; (d) $16$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (d) $16=2\cdot2\cdot2\cdot2=2^4$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 用底数 2：$2^3$ 不变，$4^2=(2^2)^2=2^4$。这里只改写，并不把两个值设为相等。

en.prompt: Rewrite each pair with the same base: (a) $2^3$ and $4^2$; (b) $9^x$ and $27$; (c) $(\frac12)^{2x}$ and $(\frac14)^{x-1}$; (d) $(\frac18)^{x-2}$ and $16^x$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Use base 2: retain $2^3$ and write $4^2=(2^2)^2=2^4$. This is a rewrite, not a claim that the two values are equal.

en.prompt: Write each expression as a single power of 4: (a) $(\sqrt{16})^2$; (b) $\sqrt[3]{16}$; (c) $\sqrt{16}(\sqrt[3]{64})^2$; (d) $(\sqrt2)^8(\sqrt[4]{4})^4$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) The principal square root is $\sqrt{16}=4$, so $(\sqrt{16})^2=4^2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Since $\sqrt{16}=4$ and $\sqrt[3]{64}=4$, the product is $4\cdot4^2=4^{1+2}=4^3$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $2^{4x}=2^{2x+6}$ gives $4x=2x+6$, hence $x=3$. Substitution gives $2^{12}=4^6=4096$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 改为底数 5：$5^{6y-3}=5^{2y+8}$，故 $4y=11$、$y=\frac{11}4=2.75$。代入后共同值为 $5^{27/2}$；解析图以 $y$ 为横向自变量，两曲线交于该横坐标。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Base 2 gives $2^{6x}=2^{3x-9}$, so $6x=3x-9$ and $x=-3$. Both values are $2^{-18}$; the graphs intersect at $(-3,2^{-18})$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Base 3 gives $3^{3x}=3^{2x-4}$, so $3x=2x-4$ and $x=-4$. Both sides equal $3^{-12}$; the intersection is $(-4,3^{-12})$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Base 5 gives $5^{6y-3}=5^{2y+8}$, so $4y=11$ and $y=\frac{11}4=2.75$. The common value is $5^{27/2}$. In the solution plot, the horizontal variable represents $y$ and the curves meet at this coordinate.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (d) Base 2 gives $2^{8k-12}=2^{5k+15}$, so $3k=27$ and $k=9$. The common value is $2^{60}$; the graph confirms intersection at horizontal coordinate 9.

en.prompt: Solve for $x$ using systematic trial and check using graphing technology. Round to one decimal place: (a) $2=1.07^x$; (b) $3=1.1^x$; (c) $0.5=1.2^{x-1}$; (d) $5=1.08^{x+2}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $1.07^{10.2}\approx1.99395<2$ and $1.07^{10.3}\approx2.00749>2$. Refine to $1.07^{10.2447}<2<1.07^{10.2448}$. The graph of $1.07^x-2$ crosses zero at $x\approx10.24477$, so $x\approx10.2$ to one decimal place.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $1.1^{11.5}\approx2.99237<3$ and $1.1^{11.6}\approx3.02103>3$. Refining gives $1.1^{11.5267}<3<1.1^{11.5268}$. The difference graph has zero near $11.52670$, so $x\approx11.5$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) At $x=-2.9$, $1.2^{x-1}\approx0.49113<0.5$; at $x=-2.8$, it is about $0.50016>0.5$. Trials at $-2.8018$ and $-2.8017$ bracket the root. The difference graph gives $x\approx-2.80178$, hence $x\approx-2.8$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (d) At $x=18.9$, $1.08^{x+2}\approx4.99524<5$; at $x=19.0$, it is about $5.03383>5$. Trials at $18.9123$ and $18.9124$ bracket the root. The difference graph gives $x\approx18.91237$, hence $x\approx18.9$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 画差函数 $F(t)=10(1.04)^t-100$。在 $t=58.7083$ 与 $58.7085$ 时符号由负变正，零点横坐标约为 $58.70839$，所以 $t\approx58.71$。代入未舍入值时原两边约为 100。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (e) 画 $F(t)=2^t-3^{t-1}$；在 $2.7095$ 与 $2.7096$ 之间过零，读得 $t\approx2.709511$，故 $t\approx2.71$。也可把方程写为 $(\frac23)^t=\frac13$，左边严格递减，说明只有一个解。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Graph $F(t)=10(1.04)^t-100$. Its sign changes from negative to positive between $58.7083$ and $58.7085$, with zero at about $58.70839$. Thus $t\approx58.71$; substitution of the unrounded value makes both sides about 100.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Graph $F(t)=(\frac12)^{2t}-10$. Its zero is about $-1.660964$, between $-1.6610$ and $-1.6609$, so $t\approx-1.66$. A negative $t$ is reasonable because the base is below 1 while the value 10 exceeds 1.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Graph $F(t)=(\frac14)^{t/3}-12$. Its zero is about $-5.377444$, between $-5.3775$ and $-5.3774$, hence $t\approx-5.38$. Then $t/3\approx-1.792481$ and the exponential value is about 12.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (d) Graph $F(t)=25(\frac12)^{t/4}-100$. The zero is $t=-8$. Substitution gives $25(\frac12)^{-2}=25\cdot4=100$, so this solution is exact.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (e) Graph $F(t)=2^t-3^{t-1}$. It crosses zero between $2.7095$ and $2.7096$, at about $2.709511$, so $t\approx2.71$. Equivalently $(\frac23)^t=\frac13$ has a strictly decreasing left side, confirming uniqueness.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (f) Graph $F(t)=5^{t-2}-4^t$ with window $13.5\le t\le15$. Its zero lies between $14.4251$ and $14.4252$, at about $14.425135$, so $t\approx14.43$. The equivalent equation $(\frac54)^t=25$ confirms a unique solution.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (g) Graph $F(t)=8^{t+1}-3^{t-1}$ on $-4\le t\le-2$ to reveal the crossing. Its zero is between $-3.2402$ and $-3.2401$, about $-3.240170$, giving $t\approx-3.24$. The equivalent equation $(\frac83)^t=\frac1{24}$ has a strictly increasing left side, so there is one root.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (h) Graph $F(t)=7^{2t+1}-4^{t-2}$. The zero is between $-1.8833$ and $-1.8832$, about $-1.883237$, so $t\approx-1.88$. The equivalent equation $(\frac{49}4)^t=\frac1{112}$ has base above 1, confirming uniqueness.

exercises.prompt: 海鲜若没有保持冷冻（低于 $0^\circ\mathrm C$），会因细菌生长而变质。相对变质速率满足 $R=100(2.7)^{T/8}$，其中 $T$ 为摄氏温度。(a) 画 $0^\circ\mathrm C$ 到 $25^\circ\mathrm C$ 的 $R$ 对 $T$ 图像。(b) 用图预测 $R$ 加倍到 200 时的温度。(c) $15^\circ\mathrm C$ 时 $R$ 是多少？(d) 若最大可接受 $R$ 为 500，最高储藏温度是多少？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 在给定区间 $0\le T\le25$，指数底数 2.7 大于 1，图像递增、向上弯曲。点为 $(0,100),(8,270),(16,729),(24,1968.3),(25,2228.5)$（末点为近似值）；以这些点画平滑指数曲线，横轴标温度，纵轴标速率指标 $R$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 画水平线 $R=200$，与曲线交点横坐标约为 $T=5.58$。用试值核对：$R(5.58)\approx199.93$，$R(5.59)\approx200.18$，所以图解预测约 $5.6^\circ\mathrm C$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 代入 $T=15$：$R=100(2.7)^{15/8}\approx643.8831$，因此相对变质速率指标约为 643.9（以 $0^\circ\mathrm C$ 时的 100 为基准）。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (d) 要求 $100(2.7)^{T/8}\le500$。在图上找 $R=500$ 的交点：$T\approx12.96298$。由于 $R$ 递增，允许温度满足 $T\le12.96298\ldots^\circ\mathrm C$；在题给绘图区间内为 $0\le T\le12.96298\ldots$。最高约 $12.96^\circ\mathrm C$；若只能设一位小数且不得超过阈值，可选 $12.9^\circ\mathrm C$。

exercises.answer: (a) 递增指数曲线；(b) 约 $5.6^\circ\mathrm C$；(c) $R\approx643.9$；(d) 数学阈值约 $12.963^\circ\mathrm C$。

en.prompt: If seafood is not kept frozen (below $0^\circ\mathrm C$), bacterial growth causes spoilage. The relative spoilage rate is modelled by $R=100(2.7)^{T/8}$, where $T$ is temperature in degrees Celsius. (a) Sketch $R$ versus $T$ from $0^\circ\mathrm C$ to $25^\circ\mathrm C$. (b) Use the graph to predict the temperature at which the rate doubles to 200. (c) Find the relative rate at $15^\circ\mathrm C$. (d) If the maximum acceptable relative rate is 500, what is the maximum storage temperature?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) On $0\le T\le25$, base 2.7 exceeds 1, so the graph increases and curves upward. Points are $(0,100),(8,270),(16,729),(24,1968.3),(25,2228.5)$. The final ordinate is approximate. Draw a smooth exponential curve with temperature on the horizontal axis and the relative-rate index $R$ vertically.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) The horizontal line $R=200$ meets the curve at about $T=5.58$. Trial checks give $R(5.58)\approx199.93$ and $R(5.59)\approx200.18$, so the graph predicts about $5.6^\circ\mathrm C$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Substitute $T=15$: $R=100(2.7)^{15/8}\approx643.8831$. The relative-rate index is therefore about 643.9, using 100 at $0^\circ\mathrm C$ as the baseline.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (d) Require $100(2.7)^{T/8}\le500$. The graph meets $R=500$ at $T\approx12.96298$. Since $R$ increases, acceptable temperatures satisfy $T\le12.96298\ldots^\circ\mathrm C$; within the plotted interval, $0\le T\le12.96298\ldots$. The maximum is about $12.96^\circ\mathrm C$. A one-decimal setting that must stay below the limit is $12.9^\circ\mathrm C$.

en.answer: (a) Increasing exponential curve; (b) about $5.6^\circ\mathrm C$; (c) $R\approx643.9$; (d) mathematical threshold about $12.963^\circ\mathrm C$.

exercises.prompt: 某细菌培养物最初有 2000 个细菌，每 0.75 小时数量加倍。多少小时后细菌数量为 32000？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 设 $t$ 为从开始培养起的小时数，$t\ge0$。经过的加倍次数为 $t/0.75$，所以 $N(t)=2000\cdot2^{t/0.75}$。

en.prompt: A bacterial culture starts with 2000 bacteria and doubles every 0.75 h. After how many hours will the bacteria count be 32000?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let $t\ge0$ be hours since the culture starts. The number of doubling intervals is $t/0.75$, so $N(t)=2000\cdot2^{t/0.75}$.

exercises.prompt: Simionie 需要 7000 元买雪地摩托，但只有 6000 元。银行定期投资证书（GIC）年利率为 3.93%，每年复利。他需投资多久才有足够的钱？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 以投资日起为 $t=0$，完整年末余额为 $A_n=6000(1.0393)^n$，$n$ 为非负整数。目标 $A_n\ge7000$，即 $1.0393^n\ge\frac76$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 若把模型连续延伸，画 $6000(1.0393)^t-7000$ 可得零点 $t\approx3.99899$ 年，与完整年度结论 4 年吻合。

en.prompt: Simionie needs 7000 dollars to buy a snowmobile but has only 6000 dollars. His bank offers a GIC paying 3.93% per year, compounded annually. How long must he invest to have enough money?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Take the investment date as $t=0$. Complete-year balances are $A_n=6000(1.0393)^n$, with nonnegative integer $n$. The target is $A_n\ge7000$, or $1.0393^n\ge\frac76$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Trial gives $6000(1.0393)^3\approx6735.57$ dollars after 3 years and $6000(1.0393)^4\approx7000.27$ dollars after 4 years. The first year-end reaching the target is year 4.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: For the continuous extension, the zero of $6000(1.0393)^t-7000$ is $t\approx3.99899$ years, consistent with the complete-year answer of 4 years.

exercises.prompt: 1000 元投资按年利率 8%、季度复利。(a) 写出投资价值关于时间（年）的方程。(b) 求 4 年后的价值。(c) 价值翻倍需要多久？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 翻倍方程为 $2=1.02^{4t}$。图解/试值给连续模型 $4t\approx35.00279$，即 $t\approx8.75070$ 年。不能把未舍入期数直接变成 35 个完整季度：$1.02^{35}\approx1.99988955<2$，$1.02^{36}\approx2.03988734>2$。因此若利息只在季度末入账，最早为 36 季度，即 9 年。

en.prompt: A 1000-dollar investment earns 8% per year, compounded quarterly. (a) Write an equation for its value as a function of time in years. (b) Determine the value after 4 years. (c) How long does it take to double in value?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) The quarterly rate is $0.08/4=0.02$, and $t$ years contains $4t$ quarters. Thus $A(t)=1000(1.02)^{4t}$, $t\ge0$, with initial value 1000. Actual crediting dates are $t=n/4$, $n=0,1,2,\ldots$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Four years contains 16 periods: $A(4)=1000(1.02)^{16}\approx1372.785705$, so the value is about 1372.79 dollars.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) The doubling equation is $2=1.02^{4t}$. Graphing or trial gives continuous period count $4t\approx35.00279$, hence $t\approx8.75070$ years. Do not round this to 35 completed quarters: $1.02^{35}\approx1.99988955<2$, while $1.02^{36}\approx2.03988734>2$. With quarter-end crediting only, the first sufficient date is quarter 36, or 9 years.

en.answer: (a) $A(t)=1000(1.02)^{4t}$; (b) about 1372.79 dollars; (c) about 8.75070 years in the continuous model, or 9 years at complete quarterly crediting dates.

exercises.prompt: 钴-60（Co-60）的半衰期约为 5.3 年。(a) 写出指数模型。(b) 26.5 年后样本剩原来的几分之几？(c) 衰减到原质量的 $\frac1{512}$ 需要多久？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 设初始质量为 $M_0>0$，$t$ 为初始测量后的年数。每经过 5.3 年乘 $\frac12$，因此 $M(t)=M_0(\frac12)^{t/5.3}$，$t\ge0$；剩余比例为 $f(t)=(\frac12)^{t/5.3}$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) $\frac1{512}=(\frac12)^9$，比较同底数指数得 $t/5.3=9$，所以 $t=47.7$ 年。半衰期本身为近似量，实际预测也约为 47.7 年。

en.prompt: Cobalt-60 (Co-60) has a half-life of approximately 5.3 years. (a) Write an exponential function to model this situation. (b) What fraction remains after 26.5 years? (c) How long does it take to decay to $\frac1{512}$ of its original mass?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Let $M_0>0$ be the initial mass and $t$ years since the initial measurement. Each 5.3-year interval multiplies mass by $\frac12$, so $M(t)=M_0(\frac12)^{t/5.3}$, $t\ge0$, or remaining fraction $f(t)=(\frac12)^{t/5.3}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Since $\frac1{512}=(\frac12)^9$, equating exponents gives $t/5.3=9$, hence $t=47.7$ years. The half-life itself is approximate, so the physical prediction is approximately 47.7 years.

exercises.prompt: 一张 500 元储蓄债券按年利率 6.6%、半年复利。(a) 写出价值关于时间（年）的方程。(b) 求 5 年后价值。(c) 价值增长到 3 倍需要多久？

en.prompt: A savings bond pays 6.6% per year, compounded semi-annually. Suppose you buy a 500-dollar bond. (a) Write its value as a function of time in years. (b) Determine its value after 5 years. (c) How long does it take to triple in value?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) The half-year rate is $0.066/2=0.033$, and $t$ years contains $2t$ periods. Thus $A(t)=500(1.033)^{2t}$, $t\ge0$, with complete crediting dates $t=n/2$, $n=0,1,2,\ldots$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Five years gives 10 periods: $A(5)=500(1.033)^{10}\approx691.788311$, or about 691.79 dollars.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) The tripling equation $1500=500(1.033)^{2t}$ becomes $3=1.033^{2t}$. Graphing or trial gives continuous count $2t\approx33.837615$, or about $16.91881$ years. Complete-period checks give $1.033^{33}\approx2.919514<3$ and $1.033^{34}\approx3.015858>3$. Thus the earliest half-year crediting date is period 34, or 17 years.

en.answer: (a) $A(t)=500(1.033)^{2t}$; (b) about 691.79 dollars; (c) about 16.91881 years in the continuous model, or 17 years at complete half-year crediting dates.

exercises.prompt: Glenn 和 Arlene 为新生孙子投资，计划在他 18 岁生日时有 20000 元教育金。若年增长率为 7%、半年复利，今天需要投资多少？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 两边除以 $1.035^{36}$：$P=20000(1.035)^{-36}\approx5796.65433156$。按通常四舍五入，现值约为 5796.65 元；以分为单位且需保证届时不少于目标时，应向上存入 5796.66 元。

exercises.answer: 现值约 5796.65 元；若按分存款且要保证至少 20000 元，存 5796.66 元。

en.prompt: Glenn and Arlene plan to invest for their newborn grandson so that 20000 dollars is available for his education on his 18th birthday. At 7% per year, compounded semi-annually, how much must they invest today?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let $P$ be the amount invested today. The half-year growth factor is $1+0.07/2=1.035$ and 18 years gives $2\cdot18=36$ periods. Thus $20000=P(1.035)^{36}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Divide by $1.035^{36}$: $P=20000(1.035)^{-36}\approx5796.65433156$. Conventional rounding gives a present value of about 5796.65 dollars. If deposits are in cents and must guarantee at least the target, round upward to 5796.66 dollars.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Check the unrounded principal: $[20000(1.035)^{-36}](1.035)^{36}=20000$. Today is $t=0$ and the 18th birthday is $t=18$; no extra initial period is counted.

en.answer: Present value is about 5796.65 dollars; deposit 5796.66 dollars if whole cents must guarantee at least 20000 dollars.

exercises.prompt: (a) 解不等式：(i) $2^{3x}>4^{x+1}$；(ii) $81^x<27^{2x+1}$。(b) 用草图说明怎样借助绘图技术核对答案。(c) 自编一个含指数式的不等式，并用图解求解。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 在同一坐标系画每条不等式的左、右两函数。第一幅交于 $x=2$，右侧左函数在右函数上方；第二幅交于 $x=-1.5$，右侧左函数在右函数下方。解析草图显示这些区域；用交点功能定位边界，再用上下位置选区间，不能把交点算进严格不等式。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 示例（答案不唯一）：自编 $2^x>4$。画 $y=2^x$ 与 $y=4$，交点 $(2,4)$；在 $x>2$ 时曲线在水平线上方，在 $x<2$ 时在下方。因此此示例的图解解集为 $(2,\infty)$。

exercises.answer: (a)(i) $x>2$；(ii) $x>-\frac32$。(b) 根据交点和曲线上下位置核对。(c) 示例 $2^x>4$ 的解为 $x>2$。

en.prompt: (a) Solve each inequality: (i) $2^{3x}>4^{x+1}$; (ii) $81^x<27^{2x+1}$. (b) Use a sketch to explain how graphing technology can check your answers. (c) Create an inequality involving an exponential expression and solve it graphically.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a)(i) $2^{3x}>2^{2x+2}$. Since $2>1$, retain the inequality: $3x>2x+2$, so $x>2$. At $x=2$ both sides are 64, so the strict inequality excludes that point.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a)(ii) $3^{4x}<3^{6x+3}$. Since $3>1$, $4x<6x+3$, giving $-3<2x$ and $x>-\frac32$. At the boundary both sides are $3^{-6}=\frac1{729}$, which is excluded.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Graph the left and right functions of each inequality together. In the first plot they intersect at $x=2$ and the left function lies above the right to its right. In the second they intersect at $x=-1.5$ and the left function lies below the right to its right. The solution sketches show these regions. Locate the boundary with the intersection feature, then select intervals by vertical order; strict inequalities exclude intersections.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) One example, among many possible: choose $2^x>4$. Graph $y=2^x$ and $y=4$, which intersect at $(2,4)$. The curve is above the line for $x>2$ and below it for $x<2$. Thus the graphical solution of this example is $(2,\infty)$.

en.answer: (a)(i) $x>2$; (ii) $x>-\frac32$. (b) Check using intersections and vertical order. (c) Example: $2^x>4$ has solution $x>2$.

exercises.prompt: 方程 $4^{2x}+2(4^x)-3=0$ 有实数解吗？说明理由。

en.prompt: Does $4^{2x}+2(4^x)-3=0$ have any real solutions? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let $u=4^x$, so $u>0$ and $4^{2x}=u^2$. The equation becomes $u^2+2u-3=0$, or $(u+3)(u-1)=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Reject $u=-3$ because $u>0$. The remaining value $u=1$ gives $4^x=1=4^0$, so $x=0$. Substitution gives $1+2-3=0$. Strict monotonicity confirms this is the only real solution.

en.answer: Yes. The only real solution is $x=0$.

en.prompt: If $4^x-4^{x-1}=24$, what is the value of $(2^x)^x$?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Preserving the given parentheses, $(2^x)^x=2^{x\cdot x}=2^{25/4}\approx76.1093$. Check the condition: $4^{5/2}-4^{3/2}=32-8=24$.

exercises.prompt: 每月按揭付款公式为 $PMT=PV[\frac{i}{1-(1+i)^{-n}}]$，其中 $PV$ 是按揭现值，$i$ 是每期利率的小数，$n$ 是付款期数。Tyseer 购房贷款 150000 元，等价月利率 0.25%，每月可支付 831.90 元。若利率和月供保持不变，还清贷款需要多久？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 画 $y=(1.0025)^{-n}$ 与水平线 $y=1-375/831.90$，或用试值，交点给 $n\approx239.9986$ 个月。付款按月进行，需第 240 次付款，$240/12=20$ 年；最后一次付款可作很小的尾数调整。

en.prompt: The monthly mortgage payment formula is $PMT=PV[\frac{i}{1-(1+i)^{-n}}]$, where $PV$ is the present value, $i$ is the decimal interest rate per period, and $n$ is the number of payment periods. Tyseer borrows 150000 dollars at an equivalent monthly interest rate of 0.25% and can make monthly payments of 831.90 dollars. Assuming the rate and monthly payments stay the same, how long will it take to pay off the mortgage?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: One period is one month and $i=0.0025$. Thus $831.90=150000[\frac{0.0025}{1-(1.0025)^{-n}}]=\frac{375}{1-(1.0025)^{-n}}$. The given rate is already monthly; do not divide it by 12.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Rearrange to $1-(1.0025)^{-n}=\frac{375}{831.90}$, hence $(1.0025)^{-n}=1-\frac{375}{831.90}\approx0.5492246664$. This lies between 0 and 1, consistent with a positive repayment period count.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Graph $y=(1.0025)^{-n}$ against the horizontal line $y=1-375/831.90$, or use trial. The intersection gives $n\approx239.9986$ months. Payments occur monthly, so payoff is at payment 240, and $240/12=20$ years, with a small final-payment adjustment if needed.

exercises.prompt: (a) 说明怎样把 $16^2$ 写成底数 4 的幂。(b) 说明怎样把 $16^2$ 写成另外两种不同底数的幂。

en.prompt: (a) Explain how to write $16^2$ with base 4. (b) Explain how to write $16^2$ with two other, different bases.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) For example, with base 2, $16^2=(2^4)^2=2^8$; with base 256, $16^2=256=256^1$. The bases differ from one another and from 4, and both powers equal 256. Other valid equivalent powers are possible.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 第 1 步写原方程；第 2 步用 $16=2^4$、$8=2^3$ 统一底数；第 3 步用幂的乘方法则，$4(2x)=8x$、$3(x-3)=3x-9$；第 4 步因底数 2 严格递增，令指数相等；第 5 步两边减 $3x$；第 6 步两边除以 5。

exercises.answer: 顺序为原方程→统一底数→乘指数→比较指数→移项→除以 5；$x=-\frac95$。

en.prompt: The steps for solving $16^{2x}=8^{x-3}$ are jumbled: $2^{8x}=2^{3x-9}$; $16^{2x}=8^{x-3}$; $x=-\frac95$; $8x=3x-9$; $(2^4)^{2x}=(2^3)^{x-3}$; $5x=-9$. (a) Rearrange them in the correct order. (b) Write a brief explanation beside each step.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Step 1 states the equation. Step 2 uses $16=2^4$ and $8=2^3$ for a common base. Step 3 applies the power law: $4(2x)=8x$ and $3(x-3)=3x-9$. Step 4 equates exponents because base 2 is strictly increasing. Step 5 subtracts $3x$ from both sides. Step 6 divides both sides by 5.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Check: when $x=-\frac95$, the left side is $16^{-18/5}=2^{-72/5}$ and the right side is $8^{-24/5}=2^{-72/5}$.

en.answer: Original equation → common base → multiply exponents → equate exponents → subtract → divide by 5; $x=-\frac95$.
